headline: The Ascent Ultimate Edition on Switch 2
title: The Ascent Ultimate Edition Hits Switch 2 | Cyberpunk Shooter | Gaming News
video_script: The cyberpunk shooter The Ascent from Neon Giant is coming to Nintendo Switch two as the Ultimate Edition. It launches in early December twenty twenty six, listed as December second or third depending on the source and region. It is digital only, costs twenty nine ninety nine dollars, and includes the base game plus three DLC packs. Will you play it on the go? Comment below!
description: The Ascent Ultimate Edition comes to Switch 2 in early December 2026 for $29.99 with three DLC packs. Sources: Gematsu, Nintendo Everything.
joke: Cyberpunk cities are loud, so bring headphones for the handheld.
